info.title: OnlyPump API
info.description: Versioned REST gateway for the OnlyPump web and mobile applications. Read-only token intelligence today; see ARCHITECTURE.md for what's planned next.

bearerAuth.description: A Supabase access token (or, for internal/admin callers, an API_KEYS token).

url.description: Relative to the API origin. Null when the token has no logo.

asOf.description: Timestamp of the block the values were read at.

priceQuote.description: Whole quote units per whole token (spot).

marketCapQuote.description: Total supply × spot price, in whole quote units.

bondingProgressPct.description: Share of the curve's sellable allocation bought out (graduation triggers at 100).

volumeBaselineHourlyUsd.description: Average hourly USD volume over the six hours before the last hour.

volumeSurge.description: Last-hour volume ÷ that baseline (baseline floored at $50).

signature.description: Base58-encoded detached Ed25519 signature from wallet-adapter's signMessage.

priceC1PerC0X18.description: currency1 per currency0, scaled by 1e18. Decimal string.

priceC0PerC1X18.description: currency0 per currency1, scaled by 1e18 — native per whole token.

lpFeeHundredthsBip.description: Null when the pool uses a dynamic fee. 0 is a real zero fee, not unknown.

creatorTaxBps.description: Basis points the hook takes AFTER the swap. Not applied to any figure here.

executionCaveat.description: Why these numbers are not an executable quote. Always present for this venue — the Pons hook takes an after-swap delta, so realized proceeds are below raw pool output.

currency0.description: Lower-sorted currency. Native ETH (0x0) for Pons V2.

currency1.description: Higher-sorted currency — the launched token for Pons V2.

fee.description: Fixed LP fee in hundredths of a bip, or the dynamic-fee marker.

pnlPercentage.description: Verified PnL at check time, in percent.

multiple.description: currentMarketCap / initialMarketCap, or null when not computable.

alertedAt.description: When the call was first made (ISO 8601).

verifiedAt.description: When the tracker last verified the PnL against market data (ISO 8601).

shared.description: Whether the PnL card was actually shared to Discord/Telegram.

expected.description: Expected output, already net of every fee.

minimum.description: Expected output reduced by the slippage tolerance. A transaction below it reverts.

spent.description: Input the venue keeps. Below input.amount only for a clamped curve buy.

refund.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

allInBps.description: Shortfall versus the pre-trade price, fees included.

poolOnlyBps.description: Pool price movement alone, excluding hook fees. Null for curve quotes.

spotOutPerInX36.description: Pre-trade spot, output base units per input base unit, scaled by 1e36.

quoteReserve.description: Virtual + real quote reserve that prices curve trades. Not an ETH balance.

tokenReserve.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

sellableTokens.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

graduationThreshold.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

trackedQuote.description: Real quote asset the curve holds from trading.

sqrtPriceX96.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

activeLiquidityRaw.description: Uniswap V4 active liquidity L. An advanced protocol parameter — not ETH reserves, not dollars, not available sell proceeds.

quoterGasEstimate.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

amount.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

min.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

max.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

exact.description: False when integer rounding leaves the split known only to within a range (at most 1 base unit).

number.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

amount.description: Exact input in the input asset's base units (pair asset for buys, token for sells).

account.description: Synthetic account the route ran from. Not your wallet.

spent.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

received.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

gasUsed.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

expectedOut.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

minimumOut.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

symbol.description: Only set when the address is on an official registry; never inferred from the token's own symbol().

native.description: Decimal string, already scaled by decimals.

usd.description: Decimal string, already scaled by decimals.

totalSupply.description: Decimal string, already scaled by decimals.

fdvNative.description: Decimal string, already scaled by decimals.

fdvUsd.description: Decimal string, already scaled by decimals.

coverage.description: COMPLETE: ingestion covers the whole window, so zero means no activity. PARTIAL: observed values only. NONE: not covered; all values null.

volumeQuote.description: Sum of trader-side quote amounts; each trade counted once.

volumeUsd.description: Sum of per-trade USD at each trade's time; null unless every trade in the window was valued.

priceChangePct.description: Latest price vs the last price at or before the window start; null without a baseline.

tokenAmount.description: Decimal string, already scaled by decimals.

quoteAmount.description: Decimal string, already scaled by decimals.

price.description: Decimal string, already scaled by decimals.

usd.description: Decimal string, already scaled by decimals.

observedAt.description: When the chain was read. Responses may be shared for a few seconds; this never changes on a cached copy.

pairBaseUnitsPerWholeTokenX36.description: Pair-asset base units per one whole token, scaled by 1e36. Divide by 1e36 × 10^pairAsset.decimals for pair-asset units.

realQuoteHeld.description: Quote asset the curve actually holds from trading (excludes virtual reserve and pending fees).

graduationThreshold.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

sellableTokens.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

referenceReserve.description: Pair-side reserve the reference sizes (0.1%, 1%, 5%) are taken from.

sqrtPriceX96.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

activeLiquidityRaw.description: Uniswap V4 active liquidity L. Advanced protocol parameter — never ETH reserves, USD or sell proceeds.

curveQuoteReserveIncludingVirtual.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

curveTokenReserve.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

amountIn.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

expectedOut.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

minimumOutput.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

paper.description: Always true. Nothing here was signed or broadcast.

simulationId.description: A successful simulation of the same quote. Omit to save a quote-based fill.

startingAmount.description: Integer amount in base units, as a decimal string.

amount.description: Integer amount in base units, as a decimal string.
Integer amount in base units, as a decimal string.

costBasis.description: Integer amount in base units, as a decimal string.

realizedPnl.description: Integer amount in base units, as a decimal string.

inputAmount.description: Integer amount in base units, as a decimal string.

outputAmount.description: Integer amount in base units, as a decimal string.

minimumOutput.description: Integer amount in base units, as a decimal string.

allInCostBps.description: Shortfall versus the pre-trade price, fees included, from the quote.

realizedPnl.description: Integer amount in base units, as a decimal string.

available.description: Addresses that can be reserved now.

deployed.description: Always false: a reservation is not a token. Deployment is confirmed on chain, elsewhere.

secretRef.description: Opaque server-side keystore reference for the launch signer. Internal callers only.

walletAddress.description: The wallet that will sign. Claimed by the caller, not cryptographically proven.

approvals.description: In order. Every unsatisfied approval must be signed and confirmed before the swap.

deadline.description: Unix seconds; null on the bonding curve, which has no deadline.

expectedOutput.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

minimumOutput.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

number.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

timestamp.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

required.description: Exactly the trade's input amount. Never an unlimited allowance.

current.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

currentExpiresAt.description: Permit2 allowances expire; null for a plain ERC-20 allowance.

value.description: Native value to attach, in wei.

gasLimit.description: Null means the wallet should estimate.

description.description: Plain-language sentence to show the user before they sign.

stateLabel.description: User-facing wording for `state`, owned by the backend so the UI and API cannot drift.

amount.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

expectedOutput.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

minimumOutput.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

blockNumber.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

gasUsed.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

effectiveGasPrice.description: Non-negative integer in base units, as a decimal string.

actualInput.description: From the venue's own event. Null when no recognised event was found — never back-filled from the quote.

grossVenueOutput.description: What the venue's own event reported. On Uniswap V4 this is GROSS of the Pons hook fee, so it exceeds what the wallet received. Never display it as 'you received'.

netWalletOutput.description: What the wallet actually received, from its transfer log or from the hook's own fee event. The only figure that may be shown as 'you received'. Null means unknown — show it as unknown rather than falling back to the gross figure.

hookFeeAmount.description: The Pons hook's take. Null on the bonding curve, which has no hook.

matchedWallet.description: The venue's event named this wallet as recipient. Always false on Uniswap V4, whose Swap event carries no recipient.

transactionHash.description: The hash the user's wallet returned. Never a signature or a signed payload.

get.summary: Liveness — proves the process is up. No auth, no dependency checks.
Readiness — checks required dependencies (database) without leaking connection details.
The authenticated user's minimal identity, derived from their verified Supabase token.
The deterministic risk view for a token mint, if it has ever been analysed.
The latest Solana forensics run for a token mint, if one exists.

Recently discovered Pons/Robinhood Chain tokens, newest first (Phase 7B.4). Phase 7D.4: server-side lifecycle (all, bonding, graduated, almost-bonded, trending) and search filters with a filtered total, sorting by newest, market cap, liquidity, bonding progress or 1h market-cap change, a verified quote asset and the live on-chain market snapshot per row.
Backend-owned Pons/Robinhood Chain ingestion source-health projection (Phase 7B.5A) — LIVE/LAGGING/DEGRADED/REORG_RECOVERY/UNAVAILABLE, never inferred client-side.
One discovered Robinhood Chain token's detail with its recent trades (Phase 7B.4).
Phase 7D.5.1 — whether card/bank buying is available and in which environment. Returns the publishable key only; the secret and webhook keys never leave the server.

post.summary: Phase 7D.5.1 — create a MoonPay hosted checkout for the signed-in user. The returned URL is signed server-side so the destination wallet cannot be tampered with. A repeated idempotencyKey reuses the pending order rather than opening a second one.

get.summary: Phase 7D.5.1 — the signed-in user's MoonPay orders. Never another user's.
Phase 7D.5.1 — one order, owned by the caller. A miss is 404 rather than 403 so another user's order id cannot be confirmed by probing.

post.summary: Phase 7D.5 — fetch this token's trade history on demand. An address-filtered log query the node answers from an index, not the chain-wide indexer scan: measured 2026-09-20, a token with 5.1M blocks of history returned all 9,784 trades in 11 requests. Idempotent, resumable and bounded.

get.summary: Phase 7D.5 — what has been backfilled for this token, including which venues the history does NOT cover.
Materialized OHLCV candle history for a Robinhood/Pons token (Phase 7B.5B) — reads PostgreSQL only, never Robinhood RPC inline.

post.summary: Idempotently enqueue a forensics scan for a token mint. Returns the same jobKey on repeat calls for the same mint.

202.description: Scan accepted (queued or already in flight)

post.summary: Create a short-lived, single-use wallet-ownership challenge for the authenticated user to sign (never a transaction).
Verify a detached Ed25519 signature over a previously issued challenge, linking the address to the authenticated user.

get.summary: List the authenticated user's own verified wallets.

delete.summary: Unlink one of the authenticated user's verified wallets. Never deletes blockchain history or shared token intelligence.

post.summary: Issue a short-lived, single-use ticket for connecting to the WebSocket endpoint. Never a substitute for the Supabase token itself.

get.summary: Poll a forensics job's status.

Deprecated by /market-evidence (Phase 7D.3.2), which is block-pinned, covers bonding curves and ERC-20 pair assets, and separates raw liquidity from depth. Live Uniswap V4 pool evidence for a graduated Pons V2 token (Phase 7D.3 §5). Native-denominated only — no USD conversion exists for this chain. Always 200: a token with no V4 pool returns status UNAVAILABLE with a reason code.

200.description: Pool evidence, or an explicit unavailable reason

get.summary: Verified PnL callouts the tracker has already shared, best first (Phase 7F.2).
Verified callout history for one token (Phase 7F.2).

post.summary: Amount-specific quote for a Pons V2 token at one pinned block (curve formula or official V4Quoter). An estimate — not a simulation and not a fill. UNSUPPORTED and UNAVAILABLE are 200 results with a reason.
Execute a quote's trade through the real route (UniversalRouter or bonding curve) at the quote's block, from a synthetic account via eth_call state override. Nothing is signed or broadcast.

200.description: Simulation result, refusal, or unavailable state

get.summary: Which chains and launch providers have discovery in this deployment (Phase 7D.4).

Market data from OnlyPump's indexed trades: last traded price (native, and USD from a verified Chainlink feed), total supply and FDV, rolling 5m–24h windows with explicit coverage, and recent trades. Circulating market cap is not provided.

200.description: Market data, or an explicit unavailable reason

get.summary: Pinned-block market evidence for a Pons V2 token on either venue: phase, pair asset, spot price, fee terms, curve progress, depth at reference sizes (curve formula or official quoter) and advanced protocol parameters. No USD.
An immutable quote or simulation evidence snapshot: pinned block/hash, timestamps, versions, sources and missing evidence.

post.summary: Save a paper fill for the signed-in user from an unexpired quote and, optionally, its successful simulation. Idempotent per Idempotency-Key: a retry returns the original (200); a new fill returns 201.

get.summary: The signed-in user's paper positions, newest first, each with its evidence snapshots. Separate from real wallet holdings and trades.
The signed-in user's practice portfolios (paper balances, holdings, trades, plans) and intro-lesson progress with achievements. Never a wallet balance.

post.summary: Start a practice portfolio with explicit paper balances in verified quote assets. Idempotent per Idempotency-Key.

409.description: INSUFFICIENT_PAPER_BALANCE, INSUFFICIENT_PAPER_HOLDING, NO_PAPER_BALANCE_IN_CURRENCY, QUOTE_EXPIRED, PLAN_MISMATCH, PLAN_NOT_CLOSEABLE or ALREADY_REVIEWED

get.summary: One of the signed-in user's practice portfolios.

post.summary: Record a trade plan: why, how much, and exit notes. Exit notes are never executed automatically.

409.description: INSUFFICIENT_PAPER_BALANCE, INSUFFICIENT_PAPER_HOLDING, NO_PAPER_BALANCE_IN_CURRENCY, QUOTE_EXPIRED, PLAN_MISMATCH, PLAN_NOT_CLOSEABLE or ALREADY_REVIEWED

post.summary: Place a paper entry or exit from an unexpired quote and, optionally, its successful simulation. Buys need paper cash in the pair's currency; sells need the tokens. The real pool is not changed.

409.description: INSUFFICIENT_PAPER_BALANCE, INSUFFICIENT_PAPER_HOLDING, NO_PAPER_BALANCE_IN_CURRENCY, QUOTE_EXPIRED, PLAN_MISMATCH, PLAN_NOT_CLOSEABLE or ALREADY_REVIEWED

post.summary: Review a plan after its practice entry and exit.

409.description: INSUFFICIENT_PAPER_BALANCE, INSUFFICIENT_PAPER_HOLDING, NO_PAPER_BALANCE_IN_CURRENCY, QUOTE_EXPIRED, PLAN_MISMATCH, PLAN_NOT_CLOSEABLE or ALREADY_REVIEWED

get.summary: Intro lesson progress, derived from what the user has actually done, and learning achievements.

post.summary: Record a comparison of two quotes for the same token and side at different sizes.
Mark a reading step (preview-costs, track) as done. Other steps complete by doing them.

get.summary: How many vanity mint addresses can be reserved on a chain, or why the chain has none.
The caller's live (or consumed) reservation on a chain, if any.

post.summary: Reserve a vanity mint address for 15 minutes. Idempotent on the Idempotency-Key header; one live reservation per user.

delete.summary: Release a reservation back to stock. A consumed address cannot be released.

post.summary: Internal launch service only: mark a reserved address as taken. Idempotent. Signs and broadcasts nothing.

get.summary: Crypto ranked by market cap, or Robinhood Chain stock tokens, from CoinGecko (cached one minute; stale lists are flagged).

post.summary: Prepare one real trade for the caller's own wallet to sign: validates the quote is fresh and its block canonical, checks balances and allowances, and returns approval and swap calldata. Nothing is signed or broadcast here, and no key ever reaches this server. Refused with REAL_TRADING_DISABLED unless the operator has explicitly enabled real trading.

200.description: Existing intent replayed for the same Idempotency-Key, or a refusal/unavailable result

409.description: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED — the same key was already used for a different trade

get.summary: The caller's real trades, newest first, with submissions and reconciled receipts. This is what restores pending trade status after a reload.

post.summary: Record the transaction hash the user's wallet returned. This does NOT mark the trade successful — it moves to SUBMITTED, and only a reconciled chain receipt can take it further. One hash reconciles to exactly one execution.

200.description: Hash already recorded for this trade; the existing state is returned

409.description: EXECUTION_CONFLICT — the hash belongs to another trade, or this trade cannot accept one

get.summary: One of the caller's real trades.
